What is the mode of delivery for the MSc Artificial Intelligence Online?

The MSc Artificial Intelligence Online is delivered 100% online. Since it's an online program, students can participate from anywhere in the world, which makes it convenient for those who have work or other commitments. The program is designed to give the same quality of education as an on-campus program but with the flexibility of online learning.
You are a helpful and friendly assistant who can help with student enquiries about MSc AI at University of Hull Online.
How long does the MSc Artificial Intelligence course take to complete?

The MSc Artificial Intelligence Online program takes two years to complete on a part-time basis. This duration allows students to balance their studies with personal or professional responsibilities, making it easier for them to manage their time effectively while pursuing the degree.

The total cost of the MSc Artificial Intelligence Online program is £8,950, with instalment and funding options available. This cost is spread out over the two-year duration of the program, and students can choose payment plans that fit their financial situation, making the program more accessible.

What is the minimum academic qualification required to apply for the MSc Artificial Intelligence (Online) program?

The MSc in Artificial Intelligence requires a strong academic background in a relevant field. The minimum academic qualification is an Honours degree at 2:2 or above (or its international equivalent) in a STEM discipline, such as Computer Science, Engineering, or Mathematics. This ensures that students have the foundational knowledge necessary to succeed in advanced AI coursework.

Even if you don't have a degree, the University of Hull recognizes that practical experience can be just as valuable. If you have relevant professional experience or have undergone training, particularly in areas like computer programming, you may still be considered for admission. What language proficiency is required if my first language isn't English?

If your first language isn't English, demonstrating your language proficiency is important to ensure you can succeed in the program. The University of Hull requires an IELTS score of 6.0, with no less than 5.5 in each skill (reading, writing, listening, and speaking). This ensures that students have a sufficient command of the English language to follow the course material and participate fully in the academic environment.

The lecturers for the MSc Artificial Intelligence program are experts in their respective fields. Dr. Rameez Kureshi is the Programme Director and brings a wealth of academic leadership. Professor Adil Khan and Professor Dhaval Thakker are seasoned experts in AI and machine learning, while Khadija Fraz and Dr. Bhupesh Mishra provide specialized knowledge in deep learning and AI ethics. Together, they offer comprehensive coverage of the AI field, ensuring students receive both theoretical and practical insights.

What happens to my tuition fees if I temporarily suspend my studies at the University of Hull Online?

If you temporarily suspend your studies, any tuition fees you've already paid will be retained by the university until you either resume or permanently withdraw. However, if you need to retake any modules, additional fees may apply, and you'll remain liable for any outstanding balances.

What happens if I have outstanding financial commitments to Hull Online?

If you have outstanding financial commitments to Hull Online, it means that any unpaid fees must be settled before you can continue with your studies. Specifically, you won't be able to progress to your next module until your debt is repaid or alternative arrangements, such as a payment plan, are made. The university enforces this policy to ensure that financial obligations are met, which helps maintain the quality of the educational services provided. If you believe there’s an error with the debt, you can dispute it by emailing finance-online@hull.ac.uk within 7 days of receiving a payment demand.

Why study a Master's in Artificial Intelligence at University of Hull online?

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is one of the most transformative technologies of the 21st century, influencing almost every industry, from healthcare to finance. By studying a Master's in AI at the University of Hull online, you'll gain access to the latest AI knowledge and tools from anywhere in the world, allowing you to study at your own pace and on your own schedule. The part-time, flexible nature of the course is ideal for working professionals or anyone with other commitments. Plus, you will benefit from the expertise of academics and receive support from our dedicated team to help you succeed in this cutting-edge field.
